goal: Prod has the capacity to read 100k logged-in Instagram pages a day: healthy accounts times a per-account rate proven over 2 full UTC days with 0 Instagram verdicts. At most 2% of prod accounts outside the canary die by Instagram's hand in a day, logged-in collab walks reach 365 days deep, about 10% of accounts run as the canary and lose at most 3 an hour, and staging keeps reading as a test bed.

onMiss: Read the flags first. capacity: its line gives the healthy accounts, the proven rate and how many more healthy accounts reach 100k at that rate. If the accounts on hand (not dead) reach it, message the live job whose bind, admission or route-renew work leaves them unhealthy. Raise the proven rate through the canary job (p75). Send the owner the Slack DM he asked for, with that count, only when accounts on hand times the proven rate miss 100k; never buy accounts. An Instagram death: drop that arm's cap to the best proven rate and write the death codes on the board. canary short: fill the roster to ~10%. deep_walks: fix the error stops it names. staging_stall: undo each pause row a deploy or stale job left on, under the staging deploy lock (c63, c72); fix its top refusal. Ship staging changes directly (c50), ask only for prod promotes, merge nothing without his go on that PR (c49), send nothing outside (c37). source_error: fix the read. All on target: end the turn with no message.
